takes.title: Bent-knee dance with overhead arm shapes
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts weight through low steps, alternating bent elbows at chest height with sweeping reaches above the head, then lowers the arms and walks out.

takes.title: Side steps with open-arm accents
takes.actionDescription: The performer sways from side to side, alternating bent elbows with straight lateral reaches and raised knees, then steps out of the phrase.

takes.title: Crossing dance steps with a high knee
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with both arms spread, crosses the feet and briefly lifts a bent knee high, then alternates arm reaches before walking out.

takes.title: Dance steps with backward foot flicks
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms, alternates forward and backward foot lifts with short hops and reaching arms, and finishes with a few small steps.

takes.title: Long dance phrase with high knee lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds the arms wide through repeated knee lifts and outward steps, then brings the elbows in and settles with one hand on the hip.

takes.title: Cross-step dance with diagonal reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer crosses the feet beneath alternating overhead and side reaches, adds a bent-knee balance, and lowers both arms before stepping away.

takes.title: Dance phrase with repeated deep squats
takes.actionDescription: The performer drops into a wide squat with hands at the waist, rises into bent-knee stepping with one arm extended, and repeats the low drop before walking out.

takes.title: Cross steps with repeated diagonal arm extensions
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates crossed steps and knee bends while raising one arm diagonally and keeping the other bent across the torso, then lowers both arms.

takes.title: Dance phrase with forward leg taps
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts weight under alternating high and side arm reaches, adds forward leg taps, and relaxes the arms while turning out of the phrase.

takes.title: Dance phrase with overhead hands and a forward bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both hands together above the head, links cross steps with knee lifts and single-arm reaches, then bends forward with hands lowered.

takes.title: Long dance phrase with overhead reaches and knee lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with arms spread, switches between diagonal reaches, bent-arm shapes, and raised knees, then lowers the arms and stands.

takes.title: Dance phrase with broad reaches and side travel
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens the arms and steps side to side, lowers into deep knee bends and steps across with broad reaches, then returns to standing.

takes.title: Knee-lift dance with a low reaching accent
takes.actionDescription: The performer dances with arms held out and the knees lifting in turn, briefly dips to reach low beside an extended foot, then straightens.

takes.title: Repeated outward knee lifts with open arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates bent elbows and wide arms while lifting the knees outward, then lowers the arms and steps off to the side.

takes.title: Cross-step dance with turning reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer crosses one foot behind the other, shifts through short turns, and alternates bent-arm gestures at shoulder height before stepping out.

takes.title: Marking steps between open-arm poses
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both arms, pauses between small steps and a backward foot lift, and returns to the open-arm stance at the end.
